global_registry_hot_polling.details: No GlobalRegistry.Get< call was found in the scoped marine-snow owner. Registry property reads are in enable, hotswap, cached dependency, or cold rebind paths.

execution_phase.details: Renderer implements ILateFrameTickable and runs marine-snow simulation/render in LateFrameTick/RunMarineSnowVisualTick.

camera_bound_particles.details: Draw bounds are centered on target camera and sized by the configured shell; particles wrap around the camera shell in compute.

density_and_turbidity.details: Publisher builds target emission from depth, biome turbidity, darkness, clear-water daylight, ecology multiplier, adaptive scale, bottom silt, submerge impulse, and FrameTimeWatchdog particle scale. It normalizes this to densityScale and calls SetUnderwaterState.

flow_and_wake_velocity.details: Compute path blends flow field, dynamic wakes, propwash, shallow-water velocity, curl-noise fake, mock acoustic impulse, flow synchrony, propwash sand force, and maelstrom force into particle velocity.

flipbook_and_material.details: Shader uses baked mask and normal atlases, atlas columns/rows defaults of 8x8, life/time-driven flipbook UVs, and water-extinction lighting.

fill_rate_controls.details: Shader is AlphaTest/TransparentCutout with AlphaToMask and dithered coverage; compute appends visible particles only. Measured overdraw is pending Frame Debugger.

clear_water_bypass.details: Effective density below epsilon clears active count and sonar/fog globals, then returns before GPU dispatch.

data_vault_compaction.details: DataVault binding and buffer resolution fail closed when compaction is active; native readiness is cleared and rebind is retried by cadence.

black_box.details: MarineSnowTelemetryEntry ring is 300 frames. Non-finite state or estimated high GPU cost dumps the ring through NativeFaultDumpWriter.

budget_and_scaling.rejected_task_assumption: The stale 500/5000 hard-cap wording was not applied because it conflicts with the existing continuous budget catalog and root GlobalQualityWeight doctrine.

graphics.details: Textured atlas, normal atlas, water extinction, headlight boost, flow-tinted propwash, and camera-bound shell are present. Actual visual quality screenshot is pending.

optimization.details: GPU compute state, indirect draw, density early-out, visible-index list, continuous budget compression, and no scoped GetParticles/SetParticles were verified. Runtime timing and GC are pending.

gameplay.details: Presentation responds to biome turbidity, bottom silt, player movement, exhale impulse, weather biolume, flow, wakes, and propwash without changing gameplay authority.

device_scaling_consequences.low: Density early-out, pressure budgets, render-scale compression, VRAM pressure response, kill-switch masks, reduced flow/depth quality lanes, and alpha-clipped atlas particles preserve readable particulate without global emitters.
device_scaling_consequences.middle: More active particles, periodic flow sampling, bubble/debris response, and clear biome contrast while maintaining the same GPU buffer/DTO route.
device_scaling_consequences.high: Higher flow, collision, atlas normal, and wake detail can run within the same camera-bound shell and indirect draw route.
device_scaling_consequences.ultra: Visual-overkill count and quality lanes spend saved performance on dense, textured, flow-reactive marine snow without changing gameplay truth, save identity, or DTO layout.
